frozen_reference_method: A1 = DINOv2 ViT-B/14 + AnomalyCLIP ViT-L/14@336px visual, per-branch L2, equal-weight concat, joint L2, exact 1-NN, dist/2, dists2map(bilinear->448 then Gaussian sigma=4), stride=8 pixel metrics, image score = max of 448 map

gates.G0_comparability: IDs/support budget/model identity/geometry/metrics complete; frozen A1 replay per-category and macro P-AP abs error <= 0.0005; no missing category, NaN or misalignment
gates.G1A_development_gain: MPDD s0 K2/K4 each: macro dP-AP vs frozen A1 >= +0.01; worst-category dP-AP >= -0.03; macro dP-AUROC >= -0.005
gates.G1B_fusion_necessity: G1A plus: each shot macro dP-AP vs the locked simple control >= +0.005 with same worst/AUROC protection. E2 control = locked strongest constituent single; E4 = best pair; E6 = best fixed-weight fusion
gates.G2_reference_sampling: MPDD s1/s2 x K1/2/4: six-config mean dP-AP vs A1 >= +0.01, >=5/6 positive; per-shot two-seed mean non-negative; worst-category six-config mean >= -0.03; six-config mean dP-AUROC >= -0.005; fusion routes also >= +0.005 vs locked simple control
gates.G3_frozen_transfer: BTAD and MVTec, nine configs each: mean dP-AP vs A1 >= +0.005, >=7/9 positive; worst-category nine-config mean >= -0.03; mean dP-AUROC >= -0.005; mean dP-AP vs locked simple control >= 0; both datasets must satisfy

locked_controls.constituent_single[pair_id]: the two constituent singles of that pair, within M only
locked_controls.best_fixed[same_branches]: pre-registered fixed weights of the same branches and budget
locked_controls.best_observed_single: completed M_B, M_S, N_B, N_S, C_aligned under the same input protocol

lock_rule: Within each lock's own candidate scope, choose once by the mean of s0 K2/K4 macro P-AP; never reselect on test category, shot or later dataset. Ties within <=0.001 resolved by (1) lower measured same-condition cost, (2) fewer branches, (3) lexicographically smaller config_id

stability_flags.seed_stable_v1: each reference seed cross-shot mean dP-AP vs A1 > 0; each seed worst-category cross-shot mean >= -0.03; each seed mean dP-AUROC >= -0.005

bootstrap.stratification: within category by normal/anomalous image; whole-image resampling; shared index across candidate and all controls
bootstrap.forbidden: pixels as independent bootstrap units; treating nine reference configs as nine independent datasets

stopping_rules: E1 four factor units; E2 three singles + three pairs; E4 one equal-weight triple. No post-hoc addition of backbones/layers after seeing a category result. Gates are point-estimate screens; CIs reported alongside.
test_label_discipline: GT masks/labels only in evaluator and post-hoc diagnosis; never in the predictor, gate, or test-time parameter fit. No test-set statistics used for calibration.
